latest.title: Ongombo and Ongeama Development Programme Update
latest.content:
Today 07:00
RNS Number : 7338S
African Pioneer PLC
01 September 2026
1 September 2026
African Pioneer Plc
("African Pioneer" or the "Company")
Ongombo and Ongeama Development Programme Update
African Pioneer Plc ("AFP"), the exploration and resource development company is pleased to announce that planning work has commenced on the Ongombo - Ongeama development programme under the terms of the conditional financing and technical services agreement (the "
Definitive Agreement
") signed between the Company and Hong Kong Xinhai Mining Services Limited ("
Xinhai
") and announced on 30 July 2026.
Highlights
·
The parties plan, subject to availability of drill rigs, an initial drill programme for up to 4 diamond drill rigs split between Ongombo and Ongeama to complete the drilling required for geotechnical studies, final underground and open pit mine design and the update of the current 29Mt @ 1.1% Cu Eq JORC (2012) Mineral Resource Estimate for the Ongombo project
·
Drilling will commence once all regulatory requirements have been completed and the parties have agreed on drill hole locations and final depths
·
A considerable number of technical personnel will be required to oversee and manage the estimated volume of core to be generated by up to 4 drill rigs and recruitment is underway managed by African Pioneer's in-country management
·
The drill programme will be multi month with an additional period thereafter for the receipt of final assays
·
Discussions are also underway to agree the final mine design and plant throughput scope for the development of Ongombo-Ongeama
Colin Bird, Chairman of African Pioneer, commented:
"We are very pleased with the rapid progress in the drill program planning and this is a credit to our technical team and the highly professional approach of Xinhai and their commitment to a significant drilling campaign in the short term. The pending completion requirements in relation to the Definitive Agreement with Xinhai are well in hand. We will keep shareholders informed as matters progress."
Update on Financing and Mine Development Agreement
Further to the Company's announcement on 30 July 2026 the Company confirms that the administrative processes in relations to the conditions precedent in the Definitive Agreement are being finalised and we will announce when the conditions precedent have been completed.

Exercise of Warrants, Total Voting Rights
African Pioneer Plc ("AFP"), the exploration and resource development company with projects in Namibia, Zambia and Botswana,
announces that pursuant to the exercise of warrants at a price of 1 p per share in terms of the fundraising announced on 10 February 2025 the Company is issuing 2,100,000 fully paid ordinary shares of no par value in the Company ("
Warrant Exercise Shares
") which when issued will rank
pari passu
with the existing ordinary shares in the Company.
Application to trading
: Application will be made to for the 2,100,000 Warrant Exercise Shares
to
be admitted to trading on the main market the London Stock Exchange. It is expected that Admission will become effective and that dealings in the Warrant Exercise Shares will commence at 8.00 a.m. on or around 3 September 2026.
Total Voting Rights
: Following the issue of the New Shares the Company's total issued share capital will consist of 528,732,444 Ordinary Shares with voting rights. The Company does not hold any Ordinary Shares in treasury and accordingly there are no voting rights in respect of any treasury shares.
On Admission, the abovementioned figure of 528,732,444 Ordinary Shares may be used by shareholders in the Company as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, African Pioneer under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.

company_30s.what_they_do: AFP Ltd is a junior exploration firm focused on copper and nickel deposits in Namibia. The company holds several exploration licences and is working on drilling and feasibility studies.
company_30s.why_they_matter: Copper and nickel are key metals for the global shift to electric vehicles and renewable energy. Namibia hosts some of the world’s largest undeveloped copper deposits, giving AFP a potentially strategic foothold in a high‑demand market.
company_30s.current_state: The firm is still in the pre‑production phase, relying on external financing to fund its exploration program. Recent filings show ongoing cash burn and a need to raise additional capital to advance its mine development.

rns_narrative: The company has been busy with routine corporate reporting – AGM, annual and interim results, and updates on its mining licence status.
A series of financing announcements (including a £1.8m fundraising round) indicate that AFP is actively seeking capital to move its Namibian project forward.
There is no clear operational milestone yet; the focus remains on securing funding and preparing for the next drilling phase.

crowd_tape.dominant_theme: Quiet but a few traders are hoping the next drilling report will spark a price rally.
crowd_tape.bull_narrative: A handful of posts highlight the potential of the Namibian deposits and suggest that a positive drilling outcome could lift the share into the 3‑5p range.
crowd_tape.bear_narrative: Other commentators warn that the company is still cash‑constrained, with no revenue and a high probability of missing milestones.
crowd_tape.sentiment_shift: Overall sentiment is flat; the community is largely silent, with a slight uptick in bullish chatter around the recent fundraising announcement.

whats_happening_now.attention_check: Google Trends shows no recent interest – a dead trend that could mean a surprise catalyst would generate a big shock if it arrives.

near_term_catalysts: Completion of the next drill‑hole program in Namibia – a significant technical result could validate the deposit.
Any new capital raise that brings the company closer to feasibility studies or a construction budget.
A sustained rise in copper or nickel spot prices that increases the economic viability of the project.
expect_next.watch_for: Key signals to confirm a bounce: a drill‑hole showing >500 ppm copper, a share price break above the recent low with volume >1.5x average, or a funding announcement that reduces the cash burn rate.
expect_next.timing_regime: The stock has not yet produced a clear crash‑bottom signal. Without a deep crash (70‑95% drop) or an accumulation zone, it sits in a neutral phase of the cycle. A meaningful mean‑reversion would likely require a technical breakout or a positive drill result.

buy_vs_sell.lean: Neutral – the data does not yet support a contrarian bullish thesis.
buy_vs_sell.bull_case: If the company delivers a strong drilling result or secures additional funding, the market could revalue the share to reflect the underlying copper potential. A 100% upside from the current low could be realistic if the deposit proves commercially viable.
buy_vs_sell.bear_case: The company remains cash‑constrained with no revenue. Failure to raise capital or poor drill results could push the share back into a deeper decline or trigger delisting. A worst‑case drop of 50‑70% from the current level is plausible.
buy_vs_sell.risk_reward: Potential upside: 1‑to‑2x if a positive drill report triggers a rally. Potential downside: 50‑70% if the company fails to secure funding or the deposit is unviable. The risk‑reward asymmetry is therefore modest, not the high‑reward profile typical of deep‑crash setups.

playbook.if_bullish: Enter only after a clear technical breakout on the 3‑5p support zone with volume >1.5x average. Use a stop 10‑15p below the breakout point and allocate 10–15% of your discretionary capital to the position.
playbook.if_watching: Wait for the next drill‑hole report or a funding announcement. If the company announces a significant capital raise or a drill result exceeding 500 ppm copper, consider a small entry with a tight stop.
playbook.if_passing: If AFP is delisted, enters bankruptcy, or announces a major asset sale, exit immediately.

ai_insights.bottom_line: AFP Ltd is a Namibian junior miner with no recent catalyst; until a strong drill result or new funding materialises, a contrarian bullish stance is premature.
